title: Approval of Proposed Amendment of Rule No. 15, Part 15-E, Section I.1., of
text:
[H. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Power System
  Approval of Proposed Amendment of Rule No. 15, Part 15-E, Section I.1., of
  the Rules Governing Water and Electric Service for the Los Angeles
  Department of Water and Power for Underground Line Extensions in Public
  Property.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).
summary: Approve amendment to Rule No. 15, Part 15-E governing water and electric service for underground line extensions on public property.
